description: Literal-text search of the CURRENT source only (HEAD of master for postgres, the default branch elsewhere), like `git grep -F` (regex characters are escaped; case_insensitive=true for -i). Returns up to max_results files (default 50, max 500), each with repo_name, file_path, line_no and snippet (its first matching line). For any other commit, branch, tag, major version or date, for every match with context, or to search history, use code_search (version=, history=). Read a hit with read_file or git_show_file; cite path:line with the sha.

repository.description: Restrict results to this repository name.

text.description: Literal substring to search for. Regex metachars are escaped before searching.

name: grep_repository
